rules: Human analyst is the sole authority for accepted and rejected status transitions.
Zero agent components (supervisor, specialist, orchestrator, verifier) can write accepted/rejected status.
Agent pipeline execution ceiling is strictly review_pending.
Epistemic type preservation: HYPOTHESIS never becomes FACT upon review acceptance.
Human note != Evidence: analyst notes cannot be cited as grounded evidence.
0 auto-finalizations of investigations on review decision.
0 auto report admissions on review decision.

enforcement.code_level: AgentAnalystReviewService validates authority, epistemic immutability, and evidence provenance fail-closed.
enforcement.database_level: SQLite triggers trg_investigation_finding_legal_transition and trg_investigation_finding_no_identity_update prevent illegal updates.
